answer_1.quote: The second category of work involves the relatively new task of meme interpretation. This task aims to generate text that captures the final meaning of a meme, which we call the final message. ... Given a harmful meme, an entity in the meme, and a role played by the entity, defined the task of generating an explanation of why the entity plays the given role in the meme.
